title: Watch Codex companion: sessions at a glance

native.implementation: SwiftUI; semantic Dynamic Type styles, SF Symbols and native navigation. Values below are observed implementation literals, not shared constants.
native.units: points; typography uses semantic styles rather than fixed sizes

colors.watchCanvas: system black canvas; WatchApp forces colorScheme dark
colors.error: Color.red; destructive controls use the native destructive role

typography.family: system; no custom fonts or fixed line heights

native.depth: Flat tonal surfaces; no custom shadows, borders or decorative gradients.
native.motion: Native system behavior; no custom animation tokens.
native.layout: Content-sized vertical scroll views; no fixed breakpoint system. Watch uses snapshot order; iPhone groups running sessions before other sessions.
native.documentationScope: Native source extraction only. DESIGN.md is preserved. SwiftUI conventions are recorded here rather than inventing browser HTML/CSS or fixed font metrics.
native.verification: No detector or visual validation was run for this documentation task; no simulator or device result is asserted.

components.name: Watch session row
components.description: Plain NavigationLink. Running: accent caption2 status and headline title over 12% accent. Other: medium subheadline title over 7% white. Two-line title; one-line project; 12-point inset; 18-point continuous corner. Combine accessibility children and expose state as value.

components.name: iPhone active session
components.description: Plain NavigationLink. Title2 bold title, accent status and action, secondary project and up-to-three-line summary. System secondary grouped surface; 22-point inset; 24-point continuous corner. Combine accessibility children.

components.name: iPhone recent session
components.description: Plain NavigationLink, native status symbol, headline title, secondary project and state, tertiary chevron. No card fill. 15-point vertical padding; inset dividers between rows.

components.name: Native navigation
components.description: NavigationStack and NavigationLink; watch inline Codex title, iPhone native large root title and inline detail titles. Receipts and diagnostics remain below sessions or on connection screens.

components.name: Native actions
components.description: Watch bordered refresh/source controls with minimum height 44 and explicit accessibility labels; iPhone toolbar refresh and pull-to-refresh. Refresh disables while busy. Stop uses native destructive role and confirmationDialog.

components.name: Demo instruction field
components.description: Native TextField in List sections; watch system keyboard/dictation, iPhone multiline range 3...8. 2000-character limit with red error/count; preserve draft. Send disabled for unavailable mutation, running thread, blank or oversized input.

narrative.overview: Native SwiftUI for a Chinese-speaking developer checking existing work on an Apple Watch and companion iPhone. This replaces the original diagnostics-first list.
keyCharacteristics: Running-session emphasis and quieter recent sessions
dos: Keep every session and action explicitly simulated.
Keep device reachability distinct from Remote authentication.
Use semantic Dynamic Type and native controls.
Force the watch dark color scheme so its black canvas uses the dark accent.
donts: Do not add decorative gradients or shadows.
Do not fabricate progress percentages, login state, host status, completion or live Remote connection.
Do not add a giant disconnected card ahead of the sessions.
